a. All waters of the State of Illinois are designated for general use except those designated as Restricted Use Waters. "Restricted Use" means certain designated waters which are not protected for aquatic life.
The following are designated as restricted use waters:
1. The Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal.
2. The Calumet-Sag Channel.
3. The Little Calumet River from its junction with the Grand Calumet River to the Calumet-Sag Channel.
4. The Grand Calumet River.
5. The Calumet River.
6. Lake Calumet.
7. The South Branch of the Chicago River.
8. The North Branch of the Chicago River from its confluence with the North Shore Channel to its confluence with the South Branch.
   The Des Plaines River from its confluence with the Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal to the Interstate 55 bridge.
10. The North Shore Channel, except that dissolved oxygen in said Channel shall be not less than 5 mg/l during 16 hours of any 24 hour period, nor less than 4 mg/l at any time.
11. All waters in which by reason of low flow or other conditions, a diversified aquatic biota cannot be satisfactorily maintained even in the absence of contaminants.
